heading: INT. NIGHT AQUARIUM - SHARK TUNNEL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NIGHT AQUARIUM - SHARK TUNNEL - NIGHT
A glass tunnel curves through blue-lit water.
Sand tiger sharks glide overhead.
Footsteps echo on the acrylic.
ROSARIO (30s, wetsuit under a janitor's coverall) walks backward down the tunnel, camera drone in hand.
KEZIA (20s, scuba gear half-zipped) follows with a rolling case.
ODDVAR (50s, silver beard, pearl earring) stops to stare up at the sharks.
PRAKASH (30s, headset, laptop on a strap) types as he walks.
Check in.
units.name: ROSARIO

units.text: Cameras are looped. Door's mine.
units.name: PRAKASH

units.text: Case is cold. Heart is not.
units.name: KEZIA

units.text: Oddvar says nothing.
A shark passes.
He taps the glass.
It turns its head.
Eyes front. Nobody chats with the fish.
units.name: ROSARIO

units.text: You've got your orders. I've got mine.
units.name: ODDVAR

units.text: At the tunnel's midpoint, a pedestal holds a glass case.
Inside, a pearl the size of a plum.
Rosario sets down the drone and peels off the coverall, revealing wetsuit.
Kezia pops the case, hands her a regulator.
Prakash backs up to a pillar and types faster.
Oddvar crouches by the pedestal and runs a thumb over its latch, a faint smile on his face, while the sharks wheel closer in a slow ring.
An ALARM chirps.
Everyone stills.
That's not mine.
units.name: PRAKASH

units.text: Whose is it?
units.name: ROSARIO

units.text: Mine.
units.name: ODDVAR

units.text: He stands.
The pearl is already in his pocket.
He walks away, calm, unhurried, past the others.
Rosario lunges for his sleeve, misses, and follows him.
Kezia drops the case and runs after them both.
Prakash stays frozen with the laptop clutched to his chest.
Of course. Of course it's him.
units.name: PRAKASH

units.text: Overhead, a shark thumps the glass.
